fields.description: The WhatsApp hub entry this was installed from.
fields.label: Hub entry

fields.description: The entry's checksum when it was installed: another one on the hub means an update is available.
fields.label: Hub checksum
Command Word
fields.description: The word a sender types to run the command. Capital letters and extra spaces are ignored, and it must not match another command or synonym.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: A friendly name for the command. Empty uses the command word.

fields.label: Function
fields.description: What the command does. Only active functions can be picked for a new command.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only active commands respond to senders.

fields.label: Synonyms
fields.description: Other words that run the same command, one per line. Each must be unique across all commands.

fields.label: Show in main menu
fields.description: Offer this command in the main menu (Settings → Commands → Main menu).

fields.label: Menu description
fields.description: A short line under the command in the menu list. At most 72 characters.

fields.label: Menu order
fields.description: Lower comes first.

fields.label: Requires Linked Contact
fields.description: Only senders whose number belongs to a contact of an allowed party type can run it.

fields.label: Allowed Party Types
fields.description: Leave empty to allow all party types.

fields.label: Allowed Group
fields.description: Only members of this group can run the command. Empty allows everyone who is not blocked.

fields.label: Blocked Group
fields.description: Members of this group cannot run the command, in addition to the global blacklist in Settings.

fields.label: Reply Device
fields.description: Not used: a command is answered from the device that received it.

fields.label: List Mode per Party Type
fields.description: Per allowed party type: Allow All (the entries below are a blacklist) or Deny All (they are a whitelist).

fields.label: List Entries
fields.description: Contact groups and contacts on each party type's list.

fields.label: Disabled Inputs
fields.description: Parameters of the function the sender may not give in this command, one per line.

fields.label: Ask for inputs
fields.description: Parameters to ask the sender for when the command arrives without them, one per line: name, or name: value, value=Label, … for ready answers. Required parameters are always asked. Direct chats only.

fields.label: Settings Overrides
fields.description: Values of the function's parameters for this command only, as JSON, e.g. {"timespan": "this month", "show_zero_values": 0}. Keys must be parameters of the function.

fields.label: Message Texts
fields.description: This command's own texts for the function's messages, per language. A message without a row here uses the function's value, then the header's default.

fields.label: Disabled Replies
fields.description: Replies of the function (@reply keys) this command does not send, one per line — e.g. the text without the file.

fields.label: Runs
fields.description: How many times the command has run.

fields.label: Defaults Restored At
fields.description: When the replies were last reset to the function's defaults.
